declared.question: which gk classes the rolled form's gate must cover, through (ff|ff)
declared.rule: per class, over both arches: a class's UNROLLED form is admissible when its stack is at most STACK_BUDGET_B = 14,000 B (#613's gradient-family budget) on sm_86 and on gfx1200 and its compile finishes within COMPILE_BUDGET_S = 10 s on both (the user's per-compile budget; a unit killed there is over_budget). A class with an f shell has no admissible unrolled form: it is not attempted (the user's decision). The rolled form is gated by LOWSTACK_MIN_L = the smallest L = la + lc + lb + ld holding an inadmissible class with every l <= 2, and by any f shell: every class below the floor with every l <= 2 must be admissible (so stays unrolled, its text unchanged), every class at or above it, and every f class, is gated. The unrolled form is compiled level by level in L up to and including the floor's level, no further. Every rolled unit must itself be within both budgets on both arches; where one is not, the form is changed (more loops rolled, tables moved, the kernel split), never a budget
declared.expected: the unrolled form spills from (pp|ss) and is over the stack budget from L = 5 ((dd|ps), 14,880 B on sm_86 by hand), so the floor is 5; the rolled form is under 12 KB at (ff|ff) on sm_86 and compiles in a few seconds
